host_routes.syntax: io qualification revoke [member] ADDRESS TERMINAL PURPOSE

host_routes.syntax: position limits set RPM RATE RAMP case NAME
host_routes.reason: Wired bench 16 (D6/D12): the explicit, named install of host position limits for the selected axis (rpm 1..3000, rate 1..2,560,000 increments/s, minimum ramp 0..2000 ms). RAM only; recover, useaddr, a configuration or host tuple change, position limits default (revokePositionLimits) and a restart end it. Selected-axis finite moves and staging use it; interrupts keep their original move's limits; group moves, input-started moves and homing keep the defaults. Move results echo the case and values. No register is written and no frame is sent.

host_routes.syntax: communication qualification install FIELD VALUE stationary effects route-back [dip-off]
host_routes.reason: Wired bench 17: states one exact address, baud or format change for the selected target. dip-off (address only) states that SW2-SW5 go OFF before the activation restart. Bound to target, binding, configuration and host serial generations, 60 s; a parsed communication begin takes it before any check, and a begin without it is refused before TX.
Clears the stated communication facts; no bus traffic.

host_routes.syntax: persistence qualification install KIND stationary effects route-back backup TOKEN [complete-backup]
host_routes.reason: Wired bench 17: states one save with the field-table token (first 32 bits of its SHA-256), bound to the persistence endpoint (the confirmed responding endpoint inside a communication session, else the selected axis) and age-limited; a parsed persistence begin takes it before any check, and the facts, the snapshot and the prepared write must name one endpoint. Factory restore is refused (recommissioning_unavailable) until the restricted recommissioning sequence exists.
Clears the stated persistence facts; no bus traffic.
